title: Day 793: Gunmen Shoot Up Three Homes and Three Vehicles in South Culiacán, Woman Wounded by Shrapnel
detail: During the morning of Wednesday, September 23, 2026, unidentified gunmen fired on three occupied homes and three vehicles on Calle Constituyente Pastor Rovaix, between Heraclio Bernal and Pablo Macías Valenzuela, in the Josefa Ortiz de Domínguez neighborhood of south Culiacán. A gray flatbed pickup, a white Toyota Camry and a dark blue compact SUV were struck, along with the facades of a white house, a two-story gray house, and a yellow-and-orange house. Dora Aidé 'N', 52, was injured by bullet fragments inside one of the homes. Neighbors reported hearing high-caliber gunfire; the attackers fled before Army personnel arrived, and no arrests were reported.

title: Day 793: Man Killed, Bystander Wounded in Flores Magón Shooting, Mazatlán
detail: At approximately 5:23 PM on September 23, 2026, armed men opened fire on a man standing outside a residence on Calle Dalia, between Avenida Tulipán and Calle Gladiolas, in the Ricardo Flores Magón neighborhood of Mazatlán. The victim, identified in initial reports as Jorge, roughly 35, died at the scene. Juan, 45, an employee of a soft-drink distributor who was making a delivery nearby, was struck by a stray round and drove himself to a private hospital; his vehicle sustained five bullet impacts. Municipal Police, the Mexican Army, and the State Prosecutor's Office secured the scene. The attackers fled and no arrests were reported.
